title: ScsMandateVerificationAssessmentRequest
description: SCS-CAP-02 ScsMandateVerificationAssessmentRequest (amendments of 2026-09-27, "Mandate verification"). mandateId is taken from the request path. The system sets assessmentId, recordedBy, recordedAt and the authorityBoundary flags (always true). verificationStatus accepts every ScsIdentityVerificationStatus value; the capability refuses the two that are derived, not recorded, with VERIFICATION_STATUS_NOT_RECORDABLE. Dates, the jurisdiction, evidence and supersession are checked by the capability, so that the contract's failure codes are returned.

verifiedAttributes.description: What was verified about the mandate, for example grantingPartyConsent, permittedActions, frameworkScope, commodityScope, geographicScope, validityPeriod.

excludedFromVerification.description: Explicit exclusions: what was NOT verified.

verifyingAuthority.title: ScsMandateVerifyingAuthorityInput
verifyingAuthority.description: Recorded as declared: there is no registry of verifying authorities to check it against.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase (checked by the capability).

expiresAt.description: When given, strictly after verifiedAt, and not after the mandate's validUntil; may already have passed.

evidenceIds.description: At least one; each among the mandate's mandateEvidenceIds.

supersedesAssessmentId.description: An earlier assessment of the same mandate, not already superseded.
